claims.statement: Poland's renewable micro-installation base exceeded 1.6 million at the end of 2025, with photovoltaic systems accounting for 99.9%, evidencing a broad and fragmented commercial field for installers.
Poland's consumer authority reported recent enforcement and complaints involving opaque renewable-installation offers, contractual terms, promised savings, delays, and installation responsibility.
Hypothesis: installers will exchange delayed, aggregated outcomes for a private benchmark that improves quoting and transparency; willingness and competition-law-safe granularity remain untested.

contrary_evidence: Generic CRMs can already report a firm's own funnel, and many owners may view outside benchmarks as unnecessary.
The most useful local price detail may be exactly the detail that cannot safely be shared.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: deliver a free private quote-funnel audit from an export, then unlock external benchmarks after contribution and quality checks.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 150 members in year 2, 800 in year 4, and 2500 across Central Europe in year 6 at 600 PLN blended monthly revenue gives 18M PLN ARR. At 3-5x ARR and 60% founder ownership, the 5M PLN net-worth threshold is plausible, but only after lawful contribution density is demonstrated.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 10-15 hours/week for MVP, with legal review outsourced and data cleaning increasingly automated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 88-93% software margin after secure ingestion, aggregation, and support, excluding initial legal review.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 2-5 months at 1000-2000 PLN acquisition cost when onboarding is channel-assisted.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 399 PLN/month contributor tier and 999 PLN/month multi-team tier, with no sale of identifiable records.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: monthly repetition from new quotes and changing incentives; target 80% annual logo retention and increasing data density per member.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A longitudinal, outcome-labeled quote corpus segmented by building, product bundle, financing, region, and sales process
fingerprint.customer: Polish OZE installation businesses with 3-30 employees
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Installer CRM/accounting export templates and channel bundles sold by wholesalers or trade-service providers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Reciprocal benchmark cooperative with quote normalization, funnel diagnostics, and compliant cohort reports
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Contributor-installer pays a subscription for benchmark access after supplying eligible delayed outcomes
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Monthly pricing review, falling quote conversion, or expansion into a new county/product bundle

founder_fit: Founder can model selection bias, cohort reliability, and quote outcomes.
Family-company context provides an ethical single-firm prototype before any cooperative data collection.
Automated ingestion and dashboards minimize meeting-heavy consulting.
Low-cost MVP can start with standardized exports from existing spreadsheets.
risks: Antitrust exposure if reporting enables coordination; no live competitor-level price data should be offered.
Low contribution density in rural micro-markets.
Confidential customer or employee data leaking through free text.

structure.control_point: competition-safe normalization and contributor-gated access to delayed quote outcomes
structure.critical_dependency: sufficient honest contribution density under a defensible antitrust design

thesis: A contribution-gated benchmark where small renewable installers upload delayed, de-identified quote structures and outcomes and receive local, segment-specific win-rate, financing, scope, and margin diagnostics. Minimum cohort sizes and delayed reporting make it a lawful performance benchmark rather than a live price-sharing venue.
title: QuoteWin Cooperative for Small OZE Installers
uncertainties: A competition-law review must determine aggregation thresholds, time delays, and prohibited fields before any multi-firm dataset launches.
Installers may systematically omit losses or low-margin jobs, biasing the benchmark.
The 35000 PLN capital estimate and every numeric commercial assumption below are planning hypotheses.
